chunks.text: Providing expert, family-oriented dental services to multiple generations with a commitment to excellence.
Embracing modern advancements to enhance and restore your smile with state-of-the-art procedures.
Offering comprehensive dental services tailored to the unique needs of every family member, from children to seniors.
Merging our tradition of quality care with the latest dental technologies for optimal patient outcomes.

At Linden House Dental Practice, we pride ourselves on being a cornerstone of the Harrogate community, offering expert, high-quality dental care to generations of families for over a century. Our long-standing tradition of excellence in dental service has been passed down through the years, ensuring that each patient receives the best care possible in a warm, welcoming environment.

We understand the importance of family and aim to provide dental care that caters to all ages. Whether it's your child's first visit to the dentist or regular check-ups for adults and seniors, our team is dedicated to ensuring that every member of your family enjoys optimal oral health.
While we hold onto our traditional values, Linden House Dental Practice has embraced modern advancements in dental technology. Our services now include:
Reconstructive Dentistry: Offering exceptional dental solutions for restoring and enhancing your smile, including implants, crowns, and bridges.
Cosmetic Dentistry: Transforming your smile with the latest cosmetic procedures such as teeth whitening, white fillings, and orthodontics.

We believe that informed patients make the best decisions about their dental health. Our team takes the time to educate patients about their oral health, treatment options, and preventive care practices. We empower you with the knowledge you need to maintain a healthy smile and make informed choices about your dental care.

Your comfort is our priority. From the moment you step into our practice, you will notice a calm and inviting atmosphere designed to put you at ease. Our friendly staff and soothing environment make every visit a pleasant experience, helping to alleviate any anxiety associated with dental appointments.

For over a century, Linden House Dental Practice has been a trusted name in Harrogate. Our commitment to high-quality dental care and exceptional patient service has earned us a loyal following across several generations. We are proud of our reputation and continue to uphold the values that have made us a beloved part of the community.

At Linden House Dental Practice, our team of highly skilled dental professionals is dedicated to providing personalised care tailored to each patient’s unique needs. With years of experience and a passion for dentistry, our staff ensures that every visit is comfortable and effective, fostering a trusting relationship with our patients.

We believe in treating every patient like a member of our extended family. Our practice offers a wide range of dental services for all ages, from preventive care and general dentistry to advanced reconstructive and cosmetic procedures. Whether it’s your child’s first dental visit or advanced care for adults and seniors, we provide comprehensive care in a friendly, welcoming environment.
This comprehensive approach allows us to address all aspects of your oral health under one roof, providing continuity of care and convenience for our patients.

At Linden House Dental Practice, we're always accepting new patients and would be thrilled to welcome you to our dental family! Your oral health and a beautiful, healthy smile are our top priorities, and we're here to make your experience with us comfortable, enjoyable, and tailored to your unique needs.

Compassionate Care: Our experienced and friendly team is dedicated to providing compassionate and personalised dental care. We understand that each patient is unique, and we take the time to listen to your concerns and goals.

State-of-the-Art Facility: Step into our modern and welcoming dental practice equipped with cutting-edge technology including pain and discomfort-free intraoral, 3D impression-taking. We strive to create a soothing environment where you can feel relaxed and confident in the care you receive.

Comprehensive Services: From preventive care and routine check-ups to advanced cosmetic and restorative treatments, we offer a comprehensive range of dental services to address all your oral health needs under one roof.

Personalised Treatment Plans: Your journey to optimal oral health begins with a thorough examination and consultation. We develop personalised treatment plans to address your specific needs and achieve your smile goals.

As a private patient at Linden House you may pay for your treatments on a fee per item basis (payable on each day of treatment). After your dental examination, you will be given an indication of your recommended treatments (if required) and charges. Our fees are listed overleaf - we are happy to accept cash, cheques and major credit/debit cards.
Patients who are members of Simply Health or Hospital Plan schemes may be able to claim back pay-as-you-go fees up to policy limits.
Denplan Essentials allows you to make regular affordable monthly payments by direct debit to help you budget for dental treatment.

The average cost is just 65 pence per day. Regular check ups and preventive dental care is included in your monthly fee: check ups, x-rays, scaling and polishing or other hygiene treatments and preventive advice are all included.

Denplan Essentials has many other benefits including family discounts, 24 hour worldwide emergency helpline, temporary emergency treatment when away from home or abroad and payment towards ‘out of hours’ call out fees.

Dental trauma can also be covered by including Denplan Supplementary Insurance in your monthly fee. Should you be unfortunate enough to suffer an accident involving your teeth and gums, the insurers will pay the cost of repairs, including crowns and bridges (subject to policy specifications).
The cost of fillings, crowns, surgical procedures and cosmetic treatment etc. is not covered by Denplan Essentials. However we offer special discounted rates for this treatment.

For over 100 years, Linden House Dental Practice has been committed to providing exceptional dental care. Our experienced team is dedicated to upholding this legacy by offering comprehensive dental services tailored to meet the needs of every individual. From preventative care to advanced treatments, we utilize the latest technologies and techniques to ensure your smile remains healthy and beautiful.
